what.text: This page follows refugees from Somalia living in the United Kingdom, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3663 Somali refugees in the United Kingdom, 0.4% of all refugees from Somalia.
Kenya and Ethiopia host the most Somali refugees, followed by Uganda and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia in periods from 1983 to 2025, with Al-Shabaab among the opponents since 2006.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Somalia from 2019 to 2021 and in 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 411 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 36700, at the end of 2004; the main years of displacement in the data are 1998 and 2000 to 2011.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United Kingdom.
These are year-end totals for the United Kingdom only, reported to UNHCR.
